lesson: Geometry Harbor - An Area and Volume Expedition

activities.title: Arrival quay: build and revise
activities.challenge: On the sand practice pad, build a 3 by 2 by 1 cargo model from six unit cubes. Measure it, then reshape your cubes into a 6 by 1 by 1 row.
activities.reflection: I measured six cubes. Rearranging them changed the length but preserved the volume.

activities.title: Market gardens: measure growing space
activities.challenge: Study the gold 6 by 4 garden model. Count rows, calculate the planting area, and explain how many plants fit at one plant per tile.

activities.title: Market gardens: redesign the boundary
activities.challenge: Compare the gold 6 by 4 garden with the cyan 8 by 3 garden. On the 12 by 6 sand work pad, build 24 cubes in one layer, then revise to a 12 by 2 rectangle.

activities.title: Reservoir works: predict and fill
activities.challenge: Fill only the reservoir interior: x = 8 to 11, z = -7 to -5, and two layers above the cyan floor. Predict, fill one layer, then complete the second.

activities.title: Reservoir works: compare capacities
activities.challenge: Measure the cyan 6 by 2 by 2 model and the gold 4 by 3 by 2 model separately. Explain their equal capacity using base area and layers.

activities.title: Makers pavilion: design and explain
activities.challenge: On the 6 by 6 sand makers pad, design a connected room model using exactly 24 unit cubes. Measure it, revise its dimensions, and explain both versions.
